description: TSMC Process GNN Baseline architecture sweep (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.batch_size_note: Number of samples per mini-batch from randomly selected task
_comments.pooling_options: mean (global mean pooling) or output (output node only)
_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage on all nodes), vdd_only (voltage only on VDD, 0 elsewhere)
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set true to use related_pin_only slew assignment. Adds _relpin suffix to dataset/checkpoint paths.
_comments.loss_logging_note: Set loss_logging.enabled=true to save training loss at specified intervals. log_every controls frequency (iterations). save_dir is optional (defaults to loss_logs/ directory).
